content: Supported role sizes The parameter DcmDspAu- thenticationRoleSize defines the size in bytes used in both, certificates and ECU internal static role configuration. All role parameters (e.g. DcmDspServiceRole) shall have values that would fit in the amount of bytes given by DcmDspAuthentication- RoleSize .
